name: Otome-tachi no Shimai Ryouiki ~Onee-sama ni Moteasobaretai Sawada Yuki no Himitsu
original_name: 乙女たちの姉妹領域～お姉さまに弄ばれたい澤田由紀の秘蜜
source:
Otona Yuri Gakuen, an all-girl school, has a tradition where the students treat each other as sisters. Seniors are called Onee-sama instead of being addressed as senpai and, of course, imouto instead of kouhai.

This is the story of a pair of sisters,the younger Yuki and the elder Shiori. They are dorm-mates and spend their school live normally like most students usually do. But all of these are about to change... and it all starts with a kiss.
translation:
女子学校“大人百合学园”有一项传统：学生彼此以姐妹相待。低年级生不把高年级生称作“学姐”，而是叫“姐姐大人”；高年级生自然也不称低年级生为“学妹”，而是叫“妹妹”。

这是姐妹二人的故事：妹妹泽田由纪与姐姐诗织。两人住在同一间宿舍，像大多数学生一样过着平凡的校园生活。然而，这一切即将改变……而故事始于一个吻。
